title: House Always Wins

panels.shot: Wide. The Grand Casino Orfeo on the river, gold lights blurred by rain. A doorman in a red coat holds an umbrella. Elias walks past it, soaked.

lines.text: The Orfeo. Where the Choir washes its money in champagne.

panels.shot: Medium. Elias puts a gold Choir coin in the doorman's white glove. The doorman's face goes pale under the umbrella.

lines.speaker: Doorman
lines.text: A Choir coin... Sir, the Count is not receiving.

panels.shot: Over the shoulder. The gaming floor: chandeliers, roulette tables, rich guests in evening dress. Four security men in tuxedos touch their earpieces at the same moment.

lines.text: Every eye in the room counted me. None of them counted fast enough.

panels.shot: Close-up. Elias sets the scorched tuning fork on a roulette table, on red 17. The croupier's rake freezes in mid-pull.
Insert. A dark office lit by a wall of security monitors. A white-gloved hand turns a monocle on its chain. On one screen, Elias at the table.

lines.speaker: Brask
lines.text: Let him play. The house always wins.
